record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The heavens<WH08064> declare<WH05608><WTH8764> the glory<WH03519> of God<WH0410>; and the firmament<WH07549> sheweth his<WH05046><WTH8688> handywork<WH04639><WH03027>.
Day<WH03117> unto day<WH03117> uttereth<WH05042><WTH8686> speech<WH0562>, and night<WH03915> unto night<WH03915> sheweth<WH02331><WTH8762> knowledge<WH01847>.

<FI> There is<Fi> no speech<WH0562> nor language<WH01697>, <FI>where<Fi> their voice<WH06963> is not heard<WH08085><WTH8738>. <RF>where...: or, without these their voice is heard: Heb. without their voice heard<Rf>

Their line<WH06957> is gone out<WH03318><WTH8804> through all the earth<WH0776>, and their words<WH04405> to the end<WH07097> of the world<WH08398>. In them hath he set<WH07760><WTH8804> a tabernacle<WH0168> for the sun<WH08121>, <RF>line: or, rule, or, direction<Rf>

Which <FI>is<Fi> as a bridegroom<WH02860> coming out<WH03318><WTH8802> of his chamber<WH02646>, <FI>and<Fi> rejoiceth<WH07797><WTH8799> as a strong man<WH01368> to run<WH07323><WTH8800> a race<WH0734>.

His going forth<WH04161> <FI>is<Fi> from the end<WH07097> of the heaven<WH08064>, and his circuit<WH08622> unto the ends<WH07098> of it: and there is nothing hid<WH05641><WTH8737> from the heat<WH02535> thereof.<CM>

The law<WH08451> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> perfect<WH08549>, converting<WH07725><WTH8688> the soul<WH05315>: the testimony<WH05715> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> sure<WH0539><WTH8737>, making wise<WH02449><WTH8688> the simple<WH06612>. <RF>law: or, doctrine<Rf> <RF>converting: or, restoring<Rf>

The statutes<WH06490> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>are<Fi> right<WH03477>, rejoicing<WH08055><WTH8764> the heart<WH03820>: the commandment<WH04687> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> pure<WH01249>, enlightening<WH0215><WTH8688> the eyes<WH05869>.

The fear<WH03374> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> clean<WH02889>, enduring<WH05975><WTH8802> for ever<WH05703>: the judgments<WH04941> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>are<Fi> true<WH0571> <FI>and<Fi> righteous<WH06663><WTH8804> altogether<WH03162>. <RF>true: Heb. truth<Rf>

More to be desired<WH02530><WTH8737> <FI>are they<Fi> than gold<WH02091>, yea, than much<WH07227> fine gold<WH06337>: sweeter<WH04966> also than honey<WH01706> and the honeycomb<WH05317><WH06688>. <RF>the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs<Rf>
Moreover by them is thy servant<WH05650> warned<WH02094><WTH8737>: <FI>and<Fi> in keeping<WH08104><WTH8800> of them <FI>there is<Fi> great<WH07227> reward<WH06118>.
Who can understand<WH0995><WTH8799> <FI>his<Fi> errors<WH07691>? cleanse<WH05352><WTH8761> thou me from secret<WH05641><WTH8737> <FI>faults<Fi> .

Keep back<WH02820><WTH8798> thy servant<WH05650> also from presumptuous<WH02086> <FI>sins<Fi> ; let them not have dominion<WH04910><WTH8799> over me: then shall I be upright<WH08552><WTH8799>, and I shall be innocent<WH05352><WTH8738> from the great<WH07227> transgression<WH06588>. <RF>the great: or, much<Rf>

Let the words<WH0561> of my mouth<WH06310>, and the meditation<WH01902> of my heart<WH03820>, be acceptable<WH07522> in thy sight<WH06440>, O LORD<WH03068>, my strength<WH06697>, and my redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802>. <RF>strength: Heb. rock<Rf><CM>
